calls.thesis: >30M active riders, ~1B rides/yr, $1.1B TTM FCF, net-cash balance sheet; AV-disruption fear overblown given Waymo partnership, Europe taxi foothold and acquirer appeal at ~8x fwd P/E, ~5x fwd P/FCF.
calls.bull: Acquisition target: 'wouldn't be surprised if a Waymo buys them, a Zoox buys them' - low-risk acquisition at this multiple.
calls.bear: If Tesla and Waymo enter and Lyft falls to #4 in autonomy, 'that could be a real problem.'
calls.stated_price: No target; ~8x forward P/E, ~5x forward P/FCF; $5.9B market cap, $5.3B EV
